name: corpus-profile
title: Corpus profile
description: First look at a corpus: size, per-text statistics, frequent content words, keywords against the bundled reference list, recurrent phraseology and term candidates.
interpretation: Report size (texts, tokens, types; TTR is a percentage and depends on corpus size), the spread of text lengths (texts result: TOKENS, SENTENCES), the most frequent content words with their dispersion (DP near 0 = evenly spread, near 1 = concentrated), the strongest keywords (KEYNESS = log-likelihood, LOG-RATIO = effect size; a log-ratio of 1 means twice as frequent as in the reference) and recurrent 3-grams and term candidates as signs of the corpus' phraseology and topics. Page each list with result_page using the result_ids.
